Episodes.Title: Episode #4.1
Episodes.Actors: Joseph Millson, Anthony Cozens, Mark Rowley
Episodes.Plot: Uhtred receives news that Bebbanburg's defences have been weakened by Scottish attacks and plans to seize his birthright, but Edward refuses to help.

Episodes.Title: Episode #4.2
Episodes.Actors: Alexander Dreymon, Finn Elliot, Arnas Fedaravicius
Episodes.Plot: As Uhtred and his men draw closer to Bebbanburg, the prodigal son Wihtgar returns with some tricks up his sleeves. News of a treachery troubles Uhtred.

Episodes.Title: Episode #4.3
Episodes.Actors: Joseph Millson, Alexander Dreymon, Arnas Fedaravicius
Episodes.Plot: Uhtred suffers a great loss on his attack on Bebbanburg. As he retreats south, he takes some valuable captives. Aethelflaed prepares for war.

Episodes.Title: Episode #4.4
Episodes.Actors: Cavan Clerkin, Craig Russell, Alexander Dreymon
Episodes.Plot: Aethelflaed and Uhtred ally with the Welsh king Hywel to face Cnut's army of a thousand warriors at the Battle of Tettenhall, hoping that they will be joined by Edward's troops.

Episodes.Title: Episode #4.5
Episodes.Actors: Toby Regbo, Jamie Blackley, Richard Dillane
Episodes.Plot: As he lingers near death, Aethelred shows repentance. Ealdormen of Mercia vie for control of the land. Edward uses his niece Aelfwynn as a bargaining chip.

Episodes.Title: Episode #4.6
Episodes.Actors: Helena Albright, Caspar Griffiths, Ruby Hartley
Episodes.Plot: Eardwulf and his men pursue Uhtred's party as it flees through a countryside ravaged by disease. Tensions between Edward and the Mercians rise.

Episodes.Title: Episode #4.7
Episodes.Actors: Cavan Clerkin, Timothy Innes, Eliza Butterworth
Episodes.Plot: Aelfwynn suffers from the sickness sweeping the land. Edward proposes an unexpected path forward for Mercia. Cnut's kinsman Sigtryggr arrives in Wales.

Episodes.Title: Episode #4.8
Episodes.Actors: Emily Cox, Millie Brady, Helena Albright
Episodes.Plot: Uhtred reluctantly prepares to take power in Mercia but he has an alternate plan in his mind. Brida joins the Danes in attacking the Welsh.

Episodes.Title: Episode #4.9
Episodes.Actors: Millie Brady, Adrian Schiller, Emily Cox
Episodes.Plot: Brida and Sigtrggr lead the Danes to Winchester, guided by the traitor Eardwulf. Haesten ambushes Uhtred's party and seizes valuable captives.

Episodes.Title: Episode #4.10
Episodes.Actors: Alexander Dreymon, Arnas Fedaravicius, Mark Rowley
Episodes.Plot: As he awaits Aethelflaed's reinforcements, Edward besieges Winchester. Uhtred isn't convinced that conquest is really Sigtryggr's ultimate aim. Stiorra seeks to follow her own path. The wind shifts in Winchester.
